$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows'
$binary = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/fix-mutation-retry-truth/target/debug/deps/quantick_app-bdab7f0be3d8e6fd.exe'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $taskRoot
if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $binary).Hash -ne 'A2D7AADF0E084D66FE5343EABBE4E7C47DC8FE5B6A59D1647297C62CCAE45053') { throw 'Diagnostic binary changed' }
if (Test-Path Env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR) { throw 'Unexpected inherited inspector hook' }
if (Test-Path Env:RUST_TEST_THREADS) { throw 'Unexpected inherited test concurrency override' }
$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES = "$taskRoot/crates/app/config/bubbles.toml"
'DIAGNOSIS=One complete unchanged app test binary, default libtest behavior; not workspace acceptance'
"START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
"WRAPPER_PID=$PID"
"HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
"INDEX_TREE=$(git write-tree)"
"BINARY_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $binary).Hash)"
"ENV_QUANTICK_BUBBLES=$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES"
"BUBBLES_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES).Hash)"
'ENV_INSPECTOR=absent'
'ENV_RUST_TEST_THREADS=absent'
"COMMAND=& '$binary'"
& $binary
$testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
"TEST_EXIT_CODE=$testExit"
"END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
exit $testExit
